name: Wellington International Airport

curfew.v: Curfew 00:00–06:00 local for domestic flights and international departures; 01:00–06:00 local for international arrivals (11:00–17:00 / 12:00–17:00 UTC in NZDT summer). 30 minutes extra for unforeseen delays; curfew starts 60 minutes later in statutory holiday periods. Exempt: emergencies, medevac, Civil Defence, planned alternates (may not depart until curfew ends), heads of state and senior dignitaries.

customs.v: Wellington is a Customs Place and MPI Place of First Arrival. Arrival must be in working hours; outside working hours needs approval at least 5 working days ahead. Passenger details to Customs at least 3 hours before departure. Working hours are not stated.
customs.quote: If you are arriving outside of working hours, you must get approval at least 5 working days in advance.
